name: Pacifica SB
description: Pacifica State Beach (Linda Mar) is a wide, crescent-shaped beach off Highway 1 in Pacifica, popular for surfing. It is operated by the City of Pacifica.
fullDescription: Pacifica State Beach (Linda Mar) is a wide, crescent-shaped beach off Highway 1 in Pacifica, popular for surfing. It is operated by the City of Pacifica.
whatTheyOffer:
- Sandy beach for surfing, swimming, and fishing
- Walking and biking trails
- Drinking water and wheelchair-accessible facilities
- Day use only (no camping)
howToGetIt: Operated by the City of Pacifica. Vehicle day use is $9. The beach is day use only and closes at sundown. State Parks annual day-use passes are not accepted here. The parking lot is just south of Crespi Drive on Highway 1.
keywords: Pacifica, state beach, San Mateo County, surfing, coastal, Linda Mar, beach, swimming, sand
